{{nihongo|'''Miwa Shrine'''|三輪神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Kaga Province]].

{{wikidata link|Q11357406|ja|三輪神社 (津幡町)|grok=none|check_date=2026-06-02}}

'''Miwa Shrine''' (みわじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} in Aza Kitanakajō, {{ill|Tsubata, Ishikawa|Q432014|qid=Q432014}}, {{ill|Kahoku District, Ishikawa|Q1130942|qid=Q1130942}}, {{ill|Ishikawa Prefecture|Q131281|qid=Q131281}}. It stands in the hills behind {{ill|Tsubata Station|fr|Gare de Tsubata|it|Stazione di Tsubata|ja|津幡駅|ko|쓰바타역|ur|تسوباٹا اسٹیشن|zh|津幡站|qid=Q3701490}}. Its {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=former shrine rank}} was {{ill|Son-sha|Q134917284|qid=Q134917284}}.

=== Enshrined deities ===
It enshrines eight deities: {{ill|Ōmononushi|fr|Ōmononushi|ja|大物主|mni|ꯑꯣꯃꯣꯅꯣꯅꯨꯁꯤ|ru|Омононуси|simple|Ōmononushi|zh|大物主|qid=Q10936701|lt=Ōmononushi-no-Mikoto}}, {{ill|Kikurihime|it|Kukurihime|ja|菊理媛神|mni|ꯀꯨꯀꯨꯔꯤꯍꯤꯃꯦ|zh|菊理媛命|qid=Q11619891|lt=Kikurihime-no-Kami}}, {{ill|Futsunushi|fr|Futsunushi|it|Futsunushi|ja|経津主神|mni|ꯐꯨꯠꯁꯨꯅꯨꯁꯤ|pl|Futsunushi|ru|Фуцунуси|zh|經津主神|qid=Q1107286|lt=Futsunushi-no-Mikoto}}, {{ill|Takemikazuchi|de|Takemikazuchi|eo|Takemikazuĉi|es|Takemikazuchi|fa|تاکه‌میکازوچی|fr|Takemikazuchi|id|Takemikazuchi|ja|タケミカヅチ|pl|Takemikazuchi|pt|Takemikadzuchi|ru|Такэмикадзути|zh|建御雷|qid=Q1502690|lt=Takemikazuchi-no-Kami}}, {{ill|Ame-no-Koyane|fr|Ama-no-Koyane-no-mikoto|it|Ame-no-Koyane|ja|天児屋命|mni|ꯑꯃꯦ-ꯅꯣ-ꯀꯣꯌꯅꯦ|pt|Ame-no-Koyane|ru|Амэ-но коянэ-но микото|simple|Ame-no-Koyane|zh|天兒屋命|qid=Q2564508|lt=Ame-no-Koyane-no-Mikoto}}, {{ill|Himegami|fr|Himégami|ja|比売神|zh|比賣神|qid=Q22070227}}, {{ill|Ukanomitama|de|Ukanomitama|eo|Ukanomitama|fr|Uka-no-Mitama|ja|ウカノミタマ|mni|ꯎꯀꯅꯣꯃꯤꯇꯃ|ru|Ука-но митама|simple|Ukanomitama|sv|Ukanomitama|th|อูกาโนมิตามะ|zh|宇迦之御魂神|qid=Q3080728|lt=Ukanomitama-no-Mikoto}}, and {{ill|Oyamakui no Kami|ja|大山咋神|simple|Oyamakui no Kami|zh|大山咋神|qid=Q10935105|lt=Ōyamakui-no-Mikoto}}.

=== Origin ===
Its founding is said to be {{ill|836|Q24957|qid=Q24957}} ({{ill|Jōwa (Heian period)|de|Jōwa|es|Jōwa (período Heian)|fa|جووا (دوره هی‌آن)|fr|Ère Jōwa (Heian)|ia|Jowa|id|Jōwa|ja|承和 (日本)|ko|조와 (834년)|ru|Дзёва (Хэйан)|simple|Jōwa (Heian period)|sr|Џова (Хејан период)|tr|Jōwa (Heian)|uk|Дзьова (ненґо)|zh|承和 (日本)|zh_yue|承和|qid=Q1075605|lt=Jōwa}} 3), and it is considered the minor shrine "Miwa Shrine" in Kaga District, {{ill|Ise Province|be|Ісэ (правінцыя)|ckb|پارێزگای ئیسێ|cs|Provincie Ise|de|Provinz Ise|es|Provincia de Ise|eu|Ise probintzia|fa|ولایت ایسه|fi|Isen provinssi|fr|Province d'Ise|gl|Provincia de Ise|hak|Yî-sṳ-koet|id|Provinsi Ise|it|Ise (provincia)|ja|伊勢国|ko|이세국|lt|Isės žemė|nl|Ise (provincie)|pt|Província de Ise|ru|Исэ (провинция)|simple|Ise Province|sk|Ise (provincia)|sr|Провинција Исе|tr|Ise (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Ісе|zh|伊勢國|zh_min_nan|Ise-kok|zh_yue|伊勢國|qid=Q864166}}, in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}}<ref>Another candidate {{ill|Shikinai Ronsha|Q135022904|qid=Q135022904}} is {{ill|Ishiura Shrine|Q11586806|qid=Q11586806}} in {{ill|Kanazawa|Q191130|qid=Q191130}}.</ref>. There is a pond in the precincts called Ryūjin-no-Ike.

=== Access ===
* 10 minutes on foot from Tsubata Station on {{ill|West Japan Railway Company|Q502125|qid=Q502125}} (JR West) and {{ill|IR Ishikawa Railway|Q11585936|qid=Q11585936}}
